# Puretek Global Cleaning

> Houston cleaning company serving homes, offices, property managers and builders across the greater Houston area. Recurring house cleaning, deep cleans, move-in and move-out cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and commercial and janitorial cleaning. Fully insured, with 50+ five-star Google reviews. Call or text 346-615-4646.

Puretek Global Cleaning is a locally owned Houston cleaning company run by its two co-owners, Donta Polk and Kenia Castro. Residential work is quoted by home size and service; commercial and post-construction work is priced per project after a walkthrough. Service areas include Houston (Bellaire, West University, Meyerland and Braeswood, Galleria and Uptown), Katy, Cypress, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Sienna and Richmond.

## Services

- [House and recurring cleaning](https://puretekglobal.net/residential.html): weekly, biweekly and monthly house cleaning, plus initial deep cleans
- [Move-in and move-out cleaning](https://puretekglobal.net/move-out.html): full-scope cleaning for tenants, owners, landlords and realtors
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://puretekglobal.net/post-construction.html): rough, final and touch-up cleans for builders, general contractors and remodels
- [Commercial and office cleaning](https://puretekglobal.net/commercial.html): recurring janitorial, offices, retail, medical suites and HOA common areas
- [Multi-tenant office building cleaning](https://puretekglobal.net/multi-tenant-office-cleaning.html): common areas and tenant suites for property managers
